pages.title: Memory Takes Shape
pages.text: Apply Old Cloth or Relic Gold to a Respawn Totem and obtain its corresponding native summon.

pages.title: Memory Takes Shape
pages.text: Blood and Soul Gems supply later summon work while rare source materials remain tied to their real encounters.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Old Cloth gives Cloak and Relic Gold gives Mankh. Obtain materials through their real paths and encounters; the quest never grants them or requires a player/pet death.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Apply Old Cloth or Relic Gold to a Respawn Totem. Native text identifies Cloak and Mankh as the respective summons; these companion mechanics do not imply player revival.
